dogecoin.text: I (m36) still have Dogecoin in my wallet from 2014. I could have been a millionaire but sold it for $200 to buy a PS4.

I (f34) bought a Shiba Inu coin just because my coworker mentioned it casually one day. I ignored all the red flags, convinced it was going to be the next Dogecoin. Now I pretend I’m not upset while silently holding the bags, hoping one day it makes me a fortune.

M(22) I’ve always been a “YOLO” type of guy. I threw all my savings into Dogecoin last year because everyone said it was going to the moon. Now, instead of feeling like a genius, I feel like an idiot. I can’t even talk to my friends about it without getting roasted. The worst
